_source.title: 获取尺寸标注
_source.params.primitiveIds: 尺寸标注的图元 ID，可以为字符串或字符串数组，如若为数组，则返回的也是数组

title: Get the dimension
params.primitiveIds: Primitive ID of the dimension, which can be a string or an array of strings. If it is an array, an array is also returned
returns: Dimension primitive object, `undefined` indicates that the retrieval failed
